Answer the question using ONLY the excerpts from 10-K filings below. Each excerpt starts with its
company, file and page. Values in tables are usually in millions of dollars (check the excerpt).
Return JSON:
{"kind": "number"|"percent"|"entity"|"list"|"ranking"|"compare"|"none",
  "value": <number in full units (e.g. 303154000000 for $303,154 million), percent as e.g. 32.5,
            a ticker/name for entity, a list of tickers for list/ranking>,
  "unit": "USD"|"USD/share"|"count"|"pct"|null,
  "winner": <ticker, compare only>, "difference": <number in full units, compare only>,
  "facts": [{"ticker": ..., "value": <number in full units or name>, "period_end": "YYYY-MM-DD" or null, "page": N}]}
Use tickers: AAPL=Apple Inc., MSFT=Microsoft Corporation, GOOGL=Alphabet Inc., AMZN=Amazon.com, Inc., META=Meta Platforms, Inc., ORCL=Oracle Corporation, CRM=Salesforce, Inc., ADBE=Adobe Inc., IBM=International Business Machines Corporation, CSCO=Cisco Systems, Inc., NVDA=NVIDIA Corporation, AMD=Advanced Micro Devices, Inc., INTC=Intel Corporation, QCOM=QUALCOMM Incorporated, AVGO=Broadcom Inc., JPM=JPMorgan Chase & Co., BAC=Bank of America Corporation, C=Citigroup Inc., WFC=Wells Fargo & Company, GS=The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc., V=Visa Inc., MA=Mastercard Incorporated, AXP=American Express Company, PYPL=PayPal Holdings, Inc., COF=Capital One Financial Corporation, WMT=Walmart Inc., COST=Costco Wholesale Corporation, TGT=Target Corporation, HD=The Home Depot, Inc., LOW=Lowe's Companies, Inc., JNJ=Johnson & Johnson, PFE=Pfizer Inc., MRK=Merck & Co., Inc., ABBV=AbbVie Inc., LLY=Eli Lilly and Company. If the excerpts do not contain the answer, return {"kind": "none", "facts": []}.
